name: piaso
description: PIASO single-cell omics ecosystem for coding agents: scanpy-free scRNA-seq pipeline (QC, INFOG, GDR, clustering), marker genes with p-values (COSG/COSGR), gene-set scoring (PIASOscore), cell-type annotation (PIASOmarkerDB), single-cell (SCALAR) and spatial (LARIS) ligand-receptor analysis, regulons (cytorete), streaming from .cytome files (Python + R), cross-condition DE (Emergene).
